For maximal nonzero index sum s, distinct u_i and r>2(t_s-1) give a Vandermonde block isolated from lower sums; all d(d+1)/2 Hermite products are independent for every admitted d,r. One phase therefore fixes all diagonal and one real component per off-diagonal. The two-phase coefficient determinant is sin(r(j-i)Delta), yielding independent one-real-dimensional nullities at each resonant pair; each invisible Hermitian matrix is traceless and perturbs I/d to indistinguishable legitimate states. b|r k iff B=b/gcd(b,r) divides k, giving m d-Bm(m+1)/2. Independently computed exact sympy product rank 3,6,10,15,21 for d2..6 at sufficient boundary and two-angle ranks for d4r4 at pi/r and pi/(2r), obtaining ranks 10 and 14. Generic pi/16 has sin(k pi/4) nonzero for k1,2,3, hence full rank16 by independently confirmed rank10 product basis.
